coverage_notes: PQ30 and PQ35 have no skill listed in the consulted historical reward tables, so no skill record was fabricated for them.
The historical reward source groups PQ29-PQ39 as the early four-star block and PQ40 as the start of the five-star block.
The consulted current skill documentation independently identifies Side Bridge as a PQ39 acquisition source.
Community farming reports for Heat Dome Attack confirm that players experienced randomized acquisition, but they do not establish a canonical drop percentage.

research_rules: A reward listing is not automatically a guaranteed reward or an Ultimate Finish requirement.
Enemy-specific acquisition is only promoted where a source explicitly connects the skill to an enemy.
Numerical drop rates are not inferred from community farming reports.
First-clear, regular-finish, Ultimate-Finish, conditional bonus, and repeat-drop behavior remain unknown unless explicitly established.
Records are added for coverage even when mechanics remain unresolved.
